purpose: Onboarding/empty-state illustration for the popup's 'otherState' view (neither on a cart page nor a product page) — integrated as inline SVG in src/popup/popup.html so it stays crisp at popup scale and matches both light and dark themes without separate assets.
brandSource: assets/BRAND.md + src/shared/design-tokens.css (local project files, no colors invented)
renderMethod: Local SVG source rendered to PNG/WebP with sharp for archival/export use (no generative AI, no credits used). The live popup uses the inline SVG copy embedded directly in popup.html, not these raster files.
dimensions: 240x160 (base), popup rendered at 180x120 to fit the 340px-wide popup content area

alt.en: (decorative — marked aria-hidden; the adjacent text 'Open your AliExpress cart or a product page to get started' already conveys the meaning) A shopping cart with one item highlighted, next to a magnifying glass and two AI sparkles.
alt.he: (דקורטיבי - מסומן aria-hidden; הטקסט הסמוך 'פתחו את עגלת הקניות שלכם...' כבר מעביר את המשמעות) עגלת קניות עם פריט אחד מודגש, לצד זכוכית מגדלת ושני ניצוצות AI.

contrastCheck: Illustration carries its own soft brand-gradient blob background (indigo/teal at 14% opacity) so the colored line art keeps enough contrast against both the light surface (#F8FAFC) and the dark surface (#0F172A) without needing separate light/dark variants.
integration: Wired into src/popup/popup.html (#otherState, above the existing i18n paragraph) and src/popup/popup.css (.cartiq-empty-illustration). This is a local file edit only — no git repo exists for this project, so nothing was versioned or released.
notes: Colors are exact hex values from assets/BRAND.md (#4F46E5 primary, #0EA5A4 secondary, #FF7A45 accent). No AliExpress branding used.
